verdict.rationale: This axis applies to a cloud platform, but the evidence pack never documents an OCI feature for setting up automations that run autonomously in the background, such as scheduled jobs, event-triggered functions or recurring workflows. The CLI, SDKs, REST APIs and Terraform are developer building blocks, and budget alerts are an adjacent notification feature. The Select AI Agent Framework note covers sharing agent teams across schemas, not background execution. The community cronjob is a user-side workaround running on a VM, not an OCI capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
